purpose.domain_detail: Belgian apprenticeship indemnity (indemnités d'apprentissage) management system — handles apprentice records, presence tracking, accident insurance rates, social security contributions, and bank account details for apprentices and their employers
purpose.summary: Program 2-APPR interrogates and displays apprenticeship indemnity data. It navigates apprentice registry records, computes paid hours and sick hours per month, calculates accident insurance contributions, and assembles a DOA-RECORD document with apprentice and employer details for transmission. The program uses a screen-based interactive UI with function-key navigation.

notable_features: 19 CALL statements to external subprograms (0-TODAY, 2-REGIS, 6-PERSON, 4-JRPRES, 6-ASSACC, 4-NXLP, 0-GMESS, 6-TSS, 6-PAYS, 6-CARRI, 6-BANQF, 6-BANQP, 6-METIER, etc.)
COMP-3 usage for monetary/accumulator field SH-02
STRING with POINTER for building composite fields
OCCURS clauses for monthly columns in DOA-RECORD
French/Belgian HR domain: apprentissage, présence, accident, sécurité sociale
